create_grad_scaler_for_amp_training: create a NativeScalerWithGradNormCount to handle mixed precision gradient scaling during training
compute_gradient_norm: compute the L2 norm of gradients across a list of PyTorch parameters
scale_loss_and_backward: scale the loss and perform backward pass with automatic mixed precision support

save_load_scaler_state: save and load the GradScaler state dict for checkpointing and resuming training
